Position Summary
We are seeking a talented UI/UX Designer to join Novara Systems, a fast-growing enterprise software company building workflow and analytics platforms for mid-market industries. The successful candidate will partner closely with product managers, engineers, and user researchers to create intuitive, accessible, and visually appealing user interfaces across web and mobile products. This role will own high-fidelity visual design, interactive prototyping, and the delivery of design assets that enable engineering teams to ship polished experiences. The team values data-informed design, cross-functional collaboration, and scalable component-driven systems.

Key Responsibilities

Product Design and Concepting
- Lead end-to-end UI/UX design for assigned product modules, from problem definition and user flows through to final visual execution.
- Conduct user interviews, stakeholder workshops, and competitive analysis to inform design direction and prioritize features.
- Translate research insights into personas, journey maps, and experience principles that guide product decisions.

Interaction Design and Prototyping
- Create interactive prototypes to validate interaction patterns, transitions, and micro-interactions using industry-standard tools.
- Iterate rapidly on prototypes based on usability testing, analytics, and stakeholder feedback.
- Define and document interaction guidelines and edge-case behaviors for engineering handoff.

Visual Design and Asset Delivery
- Produce pixel-perfect visual designs and high-fidelity screens for web and mobile platforms, ensuring consistency across product surfaces.
- Prepare and deliver design assets, specifications, and exportable components to engineering with clear annotations and responsive behavior notes.
- Ensure designs meet accessibility standards and promote inclusive, usable experiences.

Collaboration and Process
- Work closely with product management to align design priorities with business goals and roadmap timelines.
- Partner with front-end engineers to ensure faithful implementation of designs and to iterate on feasibility and performance constraints.
- Participate in and help evolve design critique sessions, design reviews, and cross-functional planning rituals.

Design System and Quality Assurance
- Contribute to the evolution and maintenance of the company’s design system, ensuring components are reusable, documented, and production-ready.
- Audit product surfaces for visual consistency, identify gaps, and propose system-level improvements.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 2-5 years of professional experience designing interfaces for web and/or mobile products.
- Demonstrated track record of shipping product features in collaborative, cross-functional teams.

Technical Skills (Required / Mandatory)
- Figma
- Prototyping
- UI/UX Design

Other Required Qualifications
- Strong portfolio that demonstrates problem-solving, interaction design, visual design, and end-to-end product work.
- Solid understanding of responsive design principles, layout systems, and modern web/mobile interface patterns.
- Excellent communication skills, able to present design rationale to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Comfortable working in an agile product development environment and iterating designs quickly.

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- Adobe Photoshop
- Adobe XD
- Design Systems
- Experience contributing to or maintaining a component library used by engineering teams.
- Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and experience implementing accessible UI patterns.

Success Metrics
- Time-to-delivery: reduction in cycle time from design kickoff to engineering-ready assets for assigned features.
- Usability improvements: measurable increases in task completion rates and decreases in user errors on redesigned flows.
- Design consistency: percentage of UI screens compliant with the design system and reduction in ad-hoc visual inconsistencies.
- Cross-functional satisfaction: positive feedback from product managers and engineers on quality of handoffs, clarity of specs, and collaboration effectiveness.
- Adoption of prototypes: number of validated design prototypes that progress to production with minimal rework. Location and Work Mode
- India
